The host opens with a resurfaced Charlie Kirk video, credited to an X user, in which he says the Butler, Pennsylvania assassination-attempt narrative "doesn't make any sense." In it he points to the shooter being identified by the Secret Service three hours beforehand and to no one being fired (A-2658.1). She then says people close to Butler contacted her about Mark Liti ("Leiti"/"Ley" in the transcript), a Surefire Wireline supervisor who died on August 23, 2022 in what local news called a burn-barrel accident (A-2659.1). According to the host, Liti's work involved the explosive PETN, and a week before his death he allegedly confessed to his high school friend that he had taken explosives from work, which the ATF was said to be investigating. She says that friend was Corey Comperatore, who was killed at the Butler rally after an unknown woman escorted his family to the front. She also notes that Liti was Facebook friends with members of the Crooks family and that the Comperatore family is not satisfied with the investigation.

The host connects PETN to the September 2024 pager attack in Lebanon and Syria. She plays survivor stories (A-2660.1) and a 60 Minutes clip of Mossad agents describing shell companies and a "Truman Show" (A-2660.2), and shows a Reuters graphic estimating six grams of PETN per pager (A-2660.3). She then plays a May 2025 YouTube test in which 20 grams of PETN is said to match a .30-06 gunshot (A-2661.1). She raises this against the theory that Charlie Kirk's Rode microphone was rigged with PETN, and questions Benjamin Netanyahu's golden-pager gift to Donald Trump.

In the FOIA segment, the host reads her request for Kash Patel's schedule and travel for September 7–10, 2025 (A-2662.2). She says the request was prompted partly by an FBI plane that flew Richmond to Salt Lake City and back on September 8 (A-2662.1). The FBI replied that "unusual circumstances" apply (A-2662.3), and Blake Neff mocked the request on X (A-2663.1). She also plays Joe Rogan asking on Cameron Hanes's podcast who killed Charlie Kirk (A-2664.1).

In the final segments the host plays Erika Kirk breaking down on her show with Pastor James Kaddis (A-2665.1) and repeats her account of the Department of War email that called Erika an "emotional asset" (A-2666.1). She then says she recently remembered a one-day trip to Tucker Carlson's house in Maine. According to the host, Carlson told her and her husband that Erika was "very hardcore against Israel," more so than Charlie, and that she hated the pastors around him. The host sets this against Erika's later pro-Israel stance. In the comments she discusses Erika's CK trademarks (A-2667.1) and says Ben Shapiro is spreading rumors about her trip to Russia.

lines: - **Artifacts verbally referenced but not shown**: A-2666.1 (the Department of War / White House "emotional asset" email). A-2662.1 (FBI plane flight) is described in detail, but the transcript does not show whether flight data was on screen.
- **DIA scan**: the only hit is "candace Owens. com" (51:13), a merch plug, so it is not a DIA beat. There are no tip requests or bounties; M-12 is not used.

- **Name matching**: The skeleton's "Mark Liti" (transcript "Mark A. Leiti", "Mark Liti", "Mark Le", "Mark Liti", "Mark a lady") is minted as N-675. His brother is minted as N-676 under the transcript spelling "Chris Liti"; the surname may also be Liti. "Courtney Fife" (N-677, described as a former ATF agent) comes from a garbled sentence, so both the name and the role are uncertain. "Corey/Cory Comparator" is mapped to N-105 Corey Comperatore. "Cameron Hanes" is minted as N-679 Cameron Hanes. "James Kaddis" (N-665) and "Vladimir Putin" (N-624) reuse titles from staging episodes 112 and 105/111. "Blick Nef" is mapped to N-159, "Andrew Kolvet" to N-14, "Dan Bongino" to N-378, "Bill Ackman" to N-37 and "Rob McCoyy" to N-17. "The Crooks family" is linked to N-104 only as the family name.

- **Meme title spellings**: The merch meme appears in staging as "Stop Anti-Candism" (112), "Stop Anti-Candaceism" (111) and "Anti-Candacism" (113). This episode uses the 112 spelling. "Punt the Chihuahua" (M-115) also aired in episodes 111 and 116 but has not been minted in staging before, so the integrator may need to merge it.

- **Transcription ambiguities**: "PE TN", "PN", "PET and" and "PE10" all refer to PETN. "Ken Kiddening" and "Kittening" refer to Kittanning. "Mossad" is the transcript's spelling of Mossad. "306" is .30-06. "Sar Jafal" and "Hussein Teny" are survivors named in the pager clip; no nodes were made for them. X user "Crystal Smalland" is credited with finding the Charlie Kirk video and is treated as a handle, not a node.

- **Garbled passage**: around 11:53–12:21 the transcript reads "Just 2. Months after the Butler shooting, um Cory Comparator loses his life" before turning to the pager attack "on September 17th. And on September 18th of 2024"; the sentence seems to have lost words and was not inscribed.

- **Possible cross-episode links left out**: C-9957 (Charlie Kirk flew to Salt Lake City on the morning of September 10) could support C-2144 or C-2167 (episode 23), but those claims are about specific planes and chat reports. C-9964 (Rogan on the paved-over ground) is a question, not an assertion like C-1465. C-9970 overlaps the Hamptons Netanyahu call claims (C-82) without restating them. C-9968/C-9972 match C-13675 (episode 158), which is later and not linked.
- The host's inference that Erika, as Charlie's confidant, was "pushing him to be more anti-Israel"
- The host's speculation that she lied to her husband to become CEO ("I can be your queen")
- Her inference that six grams of PETN is not enough to reliably kill
- Rhetorical questions about whether Butler was an "assassination success"
- Characterizations of TPUSA as having "everything to hide"
- Of Alex Clark as lying constantly

- **Minor beats not inscribed**: a viewer comment (Haley) asks whether Andrew Kolvet is a mole in connection with a Trump remark about Miriam Adelson, and the host says she does not trust him. The host also says Turning Point has an endowment and she has not checked "the Leah files", jokes about "dictator 2028", and announces book club.
- **Sponsor reads** (PDS Debt, The Wellness Company, Ethos) and the merch plug are excluded.
